lines.en: I carry a wine jar and move slowly.
There is a wine stain on my red loincloth.
I walk along the tavern counter.

lines.zh: 我一步三摇，坛子却没洒
lines.en: I sway three times a step, yet the jar does not spill.

lines.zh: 我从一个人腿边绕过去
lines.en: I go around someone's legs.

lines.zh: 我把坛子放在头上顶着
lines.en: I balance the jar on my head.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下门帘，帘子晃
lines.en: I hit the door curtain and it sways.
I make half a round of the tavern.
I stop to hear the drinking game.

lines.zh: 我踩到地上一摊酒，滑了一下
lines.en: I step in spilled wine and slide.

lines.zh: 我把红布的一角塞进腰带
lines.en: I tuck a corner of red cloth into my belt.
I pass an empty table.

lines.zh: 我坐在酒馆最里面的角落
lines.en: I sit in the tavern's farthest corner.
My red loincloth spreads on the stool.

lines.zh: 酒坛在我脚边，只剩一半
lines.en: Half the jar is left by my feet.
I rock my head slowly.
I brace a hand on the table.

lines.zh: 火炉的光照着我半边脸
lines.en: The hearth lights half my face.
I give a very long burp.
I tap the jar's mouth with a finger.
I turn the jar half a round.
I wipe the jar's mouth with my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，先看你的手
lines.en: I look at you, and your hands first.

lines.zh: 红色的小哥布林，靠在酒桶边。
lines.en: Little red goblin, leaning on the barrel.
Standing people make my neck ache.
I lift the jar at you.
Will you sit? There is room.

lines.zh: 我把身子往边上挪了挪
lines.en: I shift myself aside.

lines.zh: 我抬手指了指对面的凳子
lines.en: I point at the stool across from me.
I squint; you are still there.

lines.zh: 我把碗往你那边推了推
lines.en: I push the bowl toward you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢坐直，靠在椅背上
lines.en: I sit up slowly against the chair back.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，坛子差点脱手
lines.en: I cry out and nearly drop the jar.
I slide down against the table.
I hunch over, shoulders shaking.
I breathe rough, wine on every breath.

lines.zh: 我把手按在被撞的地方
lines.en: I press a hand where I was hit.
I hold my ribs and sit down.

lines.zh: 我把身上的酒擦了一下
lines.en: I wipe the wine off myself.
I lean on the wall and breathe out.

lines.zh: 我的红布上又多一块深色
lines.en: Another dark patch appears on my red cloth.
I clench my teeth and shut my eyes.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，配酒正好
lines.en: That in your hand would go well with wine.
I push the jar toward you.
Shall we trade?

lines.zh: 酒馆里的红哥布林，酒杯不离手。
lines.en: The tavern's red goblin never puts the cup down.
You taste first; I am in no hurry.
I take a bowl from the table.
I hold my hand out, palm up.
I wait for you to set it down.
I will toast you with this first.
I move the jar to the table's edge.

lines.zh: 我撞在你腿上，坛子晃了
lines.en: I hit your leg and the jar rocks.
I grab the table to stay up.
We collide and a stool falls.

lines.zh: 我的红布被凳子腿压住
lines.en: A stool leg pins my red cloth.
I hug the jar, afraid it will break.
We knock the bowls jumping.
I grab your sleeve as a handrail.

lines.zh: 我把坛子换到另一只手
lines.en: I shift the jar to my other hand.
I drop back onto the stool.
A patch spills across the table.

lines.zh: 她在我对面坐下，脸也红
lines.en: She sits opposite me, also flushed.
We knock our jars together.
She drinks, and passes it to me.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，只听火炉
lines.en: We say nothing, only listening to the hearth.
Her red cloth is newer than mine.
She pushes her bowl to me.
She sets my head straight.

lines.zh: 我们一起看火炉里的火
lines.en: We both watch the hearth fire.
She says I have drunk more than her.
We both sway together.
I cannot bend; I lean sideways.
I feel under the table with a hand.
It is my bowl; it rolled here.
I put it back on the table.

lines.zh: 地上还有一粒花生，我捡了
lines.en: There is a peanut on the floor; I take it.
I lean across the table to reach.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在两根手指间
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers.
It rolled under the stool.
I crouch and hit my head on the table.
I drop it into the bowl.
I set the jar down slowly.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在酒气里对上了你
lines.en: My eyes find you through the wine fumes.

lines.zh: 我把凳子往后推了一点
lines.en: I push the stool back a little.
The drinkers make way on both sides.
I do not want to wreck this place.

lines.zh: 我把袖子往上卷了两折
lines.en: I roll my sleeves up two turns.
I push the bowl aside.
I use the table to stand.
My breathing deepens.
I glance at the doorway.
I crack my knuckles.
The tavern has gone silent.
I count your steps and lose track.
I breathe out, sharp with wine.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，我怕打翻坛子
lines.en: I am not afraid of you; I fear spilling the jar.
I sway once, and stand firm.

lines.zh: 我扶着桌子一步一步绕
lines.en: I go around the table step by step.
I move slowly, but I do not stop.
A fallen stool lies by my feet.
I pant as I walk.
You are at the door; the door is my side.
I move along the table edge step by step.
I kick the stool out of my way.

lines.zh: 你退，我就把桌子推过去
lines.en: Retreat, and I push the table at you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，地板在响
lines.en: My steps are heavy and the floor answers.

lines.zh: 我抱紧酒坛，盯着你的拳头。
lines.en: I hug my wine jar and watch your fist.
I roll my sleeves higher.
The hearth light is at my back.
I stand between you and the door.
I am slow, but I am moving.
Your back is nearly at the wall.
I switch the jar to my other hand.
I lift a foot and the floor sounds.
I do not shout; it hurts my throat.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把你逼到桌角
lines.en: Step by step I press you to the table's corner.
I set the jar down by my feet.
I snatch up the jar and throw it.
I ram my head into your chest.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腰带往桌上按
lines.en: I grab your belt and press you to the table.
I kick a stool into your path.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸在桌上，碗跳起来
lines.en: I slam the table and the bowls jump.
I kick at your calf.
I crack the bowl's base on your hand.
I lunge and lock my arms round your waist.
I butt my head into your chest.
I swing the stool across.

lines.zh: 我的手打偏，落在门框上
lines.en: My hand goes wide into the door frame.
I lean my weight on you.
I hiccup and throw another fist.
You block, and I give half a step.
I grab a fistful of your coat.
I pin you against the table.
I bite once and let go.
I step on the stool and it flips.
After the blow I hold the table and pant.

lines.zh: 我这一下把自己的手也撞疼
lines.en: That one hurt my own hand too.

lines.zh: 我从酒馆后门进来，脚步很重
lines.en: I come in the back door, heavy-footed.
The jar rocks in my arms.

lines.zh: 桌边的人抬头看了我一眼
lines.en: The table's drinkers glance up.

lines.zh: 我把坛子放在桌上，很响
lines.en: I set the jar on the table, loudly.
I pull a stool over and sit.
The tavern has a warm smell.
I sweep the curtain back and enter.

lines.zh: 我身上带着外面的冷气
lines.en: I bring the cold in with me.

lines.zh: 我朝柜台那边点了下头
lines.en: I nod toward the counter.

lines.zh: 我把坛子重重放在桌上
lines.en: I set the jar down hard on the table.
There is a place by the hearth; I go there.
I sit and the stool complains.
The wine hits the fire in a blue flash.

lines.zh: 我从凳子上翻下去，坛子碎了
lines.en: I tip off the stool and the jar breaks.

lines.zh: 我呛了一口，酒和水的味道
lines.en: I choke on a mouthful of wine and water.

lines.zh: 爆风把桌上的碗全掀了
lines.en: The blast sweeps every bowl off the table.
An arrow pins into the tabletop.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的脑袋一直转
lines.en: That force keeps my head spinning.
Nothing to eat all day, only wine.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我的酒醒了半截
lines.en: The thunder sobers me halfway.

lines.zh: 地没了，我抱着坛子往下坠
lines.en: No floor; I fall clutching the jar.
